acknowledged.thm:fixed-binary-minimax: This is the paper's delivered headline theorem and the central matched fixed-binary minimax characterization.
acknowledged.def:minimax-risk: This definition states the observed-data decision problem whose risk the headline theorem characterizes and is required to read its bounds.
acknowledged.prop:coincident-policy-reduction: This is the on-policy benchmark that clarifies the stationary estimand and distinguishes the fixed-binary lower-bound regime from ordinary sample-mean behavior.
